_comment: Consumer registry of every Node runtime AlgoVault operates (OPS-NODE-SECURITY-FLOOR-W1 CH2 R5).
Read by ops/monitoring/node-runtime-floor-canary.py on signal-1 and aoe-1: a Node binary, process, image or cron/systemd invocation with no row here pages NODE_RUNTIME_BEHIND as UNREGISTERED.
kind -> measure: container -> docker-exec (node -v in every replica) | host-binary -> exec-version (<path> -v) | image, ci-floating, dev -> none (registered, never measured on a host).
line is the Node major the row must stay on; a measured runtime on another major is LINE_MISMATCH. exempt {reason, revisit_by} stops measurement until revisit_by, then pages EXEMPTION_EXPIRED.
floor_check_host is the one host that compares the committed scripts/data/node-security-floor.json with the live index.

The ci-floating rows mirror every node-version line in .github/workflows/*.yml, and the container rows mirror docker-compose.yml's Node-built services; tests/unit/node-runtime-floor-canary.test.ts pins both.

runtimes.note: NodeSource nodejs package; /usr/bin/nodejs reaches it through /etc/alternatives. Runs the host-side .mjs monitors.

exempt.reason: build residue: the local node:24-alpine tag is the pre-W1 base image (Node 24.18, the same image ID as node:24.18-alpine3.24); nothing runs it, and a process, cron job or unit that did would be reported on its own
build residue: the pre-W1 FROM base of both Dockerfiles (Node 24.18, below the floor); nothing runs it, and a process, cron job or unit that did would be reported on its own
Q7: the bdir-panel-readiness harness image, aoe-1's only Node; aoe-1 has no host node

runtimes.note: Mr.1's Mac: brew node@24, linked over node (Q9). Not on a monitored host, so never measured.
